notes.title: Jelly Express Lunar New Year Update!
notes.content:
Hey Jelly Squad!

Chinese Lunar New Year is just around the corner! It's time to pack up for the firecrackers of the Year of the Dragon! 🐉

Legend has it that a powerful blessing will descend on this continent at the arrival of the Lunar New Year, and the jellies who receive it will usher in a lucky and auspicious year. 🎉

However, there is always a mysterious force that washes away the blessings, leaving only the mutilated treasure map, all of which seems to make the advent of the New Year a crisis ......

Brave couriers, it is for you to challenge this time! The Jelly Kingdom needs your wit and flexibility to distinguish the hidden clues in the map and find its treasure.

✨The moment you collect all five treasure chests, the blessings of the gods will descend anew, and every Jelly will have good fortune in the coming year! 🐉

Chinese New Year update is now available! 

Festive decorations, New Year looks, and new challenges, enjoy our new update with your family and friends⭐

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/e4ab273a43e71e564202d1d8db3ea238d200a96f.gif

We hope it brings joy and creates wonderful memories for all of you!

(👉ﾟヮﾟ)👉 See you all in Jelly Land! 👈(ﾟヮﾟ👈)


Join our Jelly Community

Calling all Jelly enthusiasts! Feel free to share your feedback and suggestions on our Discord!

notes.title: New level, adjusted level unlock rules, and other improvements
notes.content:
Jelly squads!

How is it going? The whole team is closely monitoring your delivery progress and experiences...

In today's regular update, we bring you the following changes to optimize your gaming experience:


 Changes to map unlocking rules: Now, after completing the beginner tutorial, five maps will be unlocked simultaneously! You can explore the subsequent worlds more quickly!

 Optimization of tutorial levels: Clearer operation guidance has been added

 New levels: Added the Hamster Wheel! Let's get spinning!



 Difficulty adjustments: Adjusted the Gem Hall and Fearless Jungle box damage mechanics; Bee-dog appearance rules adjusted; Level tweaks.


Other bug fixes, including:


 Fixed issues where Pengpeng's Butter Beach, Kimo's Gem Hall, and Xiuxiu's Fearless Jungle final levels had animation glitches that prevented progress.
 Fixed issues with Huha's Flowering Land puzzle levels getting stuck or not opening.
 Fixed the problem of incorrect save point positions in Huha's Flowering Land final level.
 Fixed the issue with custom system sticker layers.
 Fixed the problem of some UI text turning into black squares.
 Optimized the rendering performance of the Fearless Jungle water.


That's it for this update!  We hope you all will have a great time playing! 
If you have any questions or want to report bugs, please feel free to join the official game discussion group below！

(👉ﾟヮﾟ)👉 So, see you in the Jelly Land! 👈(ﾟヮﾟ👈)

notes.title: Jelly Express | Mini dev log - The physics
notes.content:
Hey Jelly Squad!
Hope you enjoyed the upgrade of our visuals! Now, let's dive into the physics of our jelly!

First prototype:
This is the very first physical prototype of our Jelly. Stretch, shrink, jump - that's all there was to our Jelly at this stage. Interaction with the world was limited, resulting in a stiff Jelly and a less-than-ideal feel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/2604cdeaa9ca2424a75587ad5992e9a20bd9a881.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/f76b1bd18cee76989b4b181d6a3d1517e0186c9b.gif

Second prototype:
The first thing we modified was the jump - a hurdle every platformer game must overcome. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/33f56a8bbf4fb5ddbe327d6ff554bd0372b7704e.png
We broke down Jelly's jumping animation into three parts: pre-jump, mid-jump, and landing, and adjusted the physical parameters for each.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/29c127679dd1ca5895b2b7516f4b2dc98b7cec10.gif
Another important change was the stretch and shrink interaction. Stretching and shrinking are actions that need to be frequently used and accurately controlled in Jelly Delivery. However, the feedback for stretching and shrinking was far from sufficient in the previous version. We added two extra stages to the stretching and shrinking of the Jelly, known as "Super Stretch" and "Super Shrink" in the project, which correspond to the physical performance when stretching and shrinking to the extreme.

The last change was Jelly's eyes. After all, eyes are the windows to the soul. When flattened or falling from a high place, Jelly couldn't just remain unfazed with a poker face, right? Half of the eye interaction is controlled by the player's input, while the other half is left to the magnificent physics.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/268b212e9e51528fce447a3666d82bfb8509ed6a.png

Even more…
In subsequent updates, we built a brand-new aquatic playground for Jelly. Correspondingly, we also added more physical feedback for underwater actions! Check out how the jellies swim!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/55801e21c577ce81ad06a5101ba67082fc018537.png

notes.title: Jelly Express | Mini dev log - Visuals
notes.content:
Greetings, Jelly squads! 

Let's take a walk through the evolution of our vibrant Jelly World on screen, and how we've tweaked it three times to make it pop, unforgettable, and oh-so adorable!

First tweak: All about making you LOOK! It's design for the eye!

In the early stages of development, we wanted our game visuals to be eye-catching enough to seize your attention. We wanted to keep it interesting, without overwhelming you, so we simplified the amount of information conveyed through the art. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/7e06f362f9ec0391c9200781c5cde30bb6ef0037.png
At this stage, color and shape were pretty much the only visual cues. We went for bold styles, like the large vibrant blocks of solid color combined with thick, hand-drawn outlines to create a look that was simple yet impactful.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/05813681a03e707a27c0dd6043b85e06833887ab.png

Second tweak: All about making you REMEMBER! It's design for the backstory!

Midway through the development, after validating our core gameplay, we started to layer in a more detailed world view and story design. With the story guiding us, we continued the bold color block representation from the first phase, while our visual elements and atmosphere leaned towards a more concrete and joyful expression.

Each world's atmosphere was finalized during this phase. For instance, the initial adventure of our jelly began in a garden filled with a lively celebratory atmosphere. Hence, our first map lit up with enormous blooming flowers and festive confetti floating in the air. Other maps included the soft sandy beach littered with swim rings, the mysterious deep-sea harboring massive machinery, and so forth.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/d97a2880c68acd2d9dcee3c640be68262fdce2a0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/981f10c8405bfe0eef41e8ad16a2d8f407258aba.png

Third tweak: All about making you LOVE! It's design to be cute!

Towards the end of development, as the level design became clearer, we made a third adjustment to the art. This time, our aim was to unify all five map scenes under a softer, cuter visual style that could reflect more detailed settings.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/d6e6fafb53b883830d02475267e6570aacb502fe.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/769ea8677137e0e8a3c6e2ad3c254af2a12ee510.png
In addition to refining the scenic art, we also created many adorable character designs. They're all jellies, of course! We've got the energetic Sunflower Jelly, a master of machinery; the gourmet Dolphin Jelly, a cooking whiz; the shy Octopus Jelly, a stone enthusiast; the elegant Bat Jelly, a born musician, and many more.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/610d1b5175a2acf6671ac29daa34ec28b07ed93f.gif
This is a delightful and joyous co-op game. We hope you and your gaming partner have an amazing experience!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42302828/67f0ed9bd2419f4f2140862f4a493ab1bcd03f5d.gif

notes.title: [230310] New DEMO Update! With new levels, visuals and optimization!
notes.content:
Hey Jelly squads!

Whats up! We would like to invite you to try out our latest demo! Which will be available from today and lasting for 1 month, we can't wait for you to play around with it and have some fun discussions about it!

For those of you who have already had a taste of our previous version, here are some of the major improvements we've made; 
- Added even more levels and challenges from the world of Jelly, which means you'll need to use all sorts of nifty maneuvers, such as stretching, jumping, and moving. And, to add to the excitement, there are some unexpected interactions you'll have to figure out to solve the puzzles...

- Addressed to the bugs and issues reported from previous versions.

- Added new levels to help you ease into the difficulty. We're hoping this will make your delivery journey even smoother this time around!

- As for the visuals, we've refined the colors to be softer and more delicate, with a fresh new UI to boot!

And for all you first-time Jelly Couriers out there, we've updated some screenshots on our Steam page. Take a look and get a feel for what's in the Jellyland for you!

Finally, we'd love for you to join our Jelly community. We look forward for any feedback and comments for this demo!
Join our Discord Here


Thank you so very much for the wait, and hope you all have a happy wiggly day!
